news.title: The brain benefits of letting children do things on their own
paras: Mom in Melbourne held a letter, ready to drop it at the town postbox past a tiny T‑junction. She wondered if letting her 8‑year‑old daughter walk alone would be safe yet teach her independence. If she trusts herself, she learns that problems are not so scary. Peter Gray, a psychologist from Queensland, said children grow strong when they try tasks by themselves. He warned that overprotectiveness can leave older kids frightened of everyday challenges. When kids practice solving tiny problems, they build confidence. Big worries later feel smaller.

sport.title: November 23, 1997: The day Novotna beat Pierce to triumph at WTA Finals and overcome a major hurdle
paras: On this day in tennis history, Jana Novotna won the women’s year-end championships to pave the way for her Grand Slam breakthrough months later On this day, November 23, 1997, Jana Novotna defeated Mary Pierce in the final of the WTA year-end championships (7-6, 6-2, 6-3) to claim the first major title of her career.

The Czech had been one of the best players in the world over the past five years, but on several big occasions stumbled in the moment of truth. The confidence she accumulated thanks to this success probably helped her to win her first and only Grand Slam singles title six months later at Wimbledon .

sport.title: Carlos Alcaraz makes comment about Jannik Sinner straight after winning the ATP Finals
paras: Carlos Alcaraz won the ATP Finals for the first time in Turin, a tournament that was notably missing Jannik Sinner. Alcaraz had never won the ATP Finals before this year, having come closest to doing so in 2025 when he lost in the final to Sinner .

Alcaraz knows exactly what it is like to struggle with injury, having missed nearly five months of competition this year. Following Alcaraz beating Zverev in the final of the ATP Finals, he was asked just how he feels about not having his biggest rival around him on tour right now.
